payout_quote: Invite your friends and family to open a qualifying personal checking account and receive $25 for each referral. Earn up to $100.
steps: Refer friends: they open a qualifying personal checking account online using promo code REFER25, or mention your name and phone number when opening in a branch, or take a printed referral card
Friend must not currently have a checking account with ACNB; their new qualifying account must be opened and in good standing
$25 is deposited to your account per qualifying referral (or provided as an official check if you have no transaction account)
catches: Cap: up to $100 total in referral gifts (4 x $25)
Friend must be a new-to-ACNB checking customer
Friend's account must be in good standing for you to receive the $25 credit
Each $25 gift may be subject to IRS Form 1099 reporting
biggest_catch: Simple $25 per referral — but the well runs dry at $100 total.
eligibility: ACNB Bank customers; referred friends must be new-to-ACNB checking customers
timing: Paid once the friend's new qualifying account is opened
